stemMd: What is the greatest number of days on which Copper and Textile can be displayed simultaneously?
explanationMd: Copper’s feasible set is{2,3,5}; Textile’s is{1,2,3,4}. Their intersection is{2,3}, containing two days. The separate three-day display minimum can still be met outside that intersection.

distractorRationale.a: Both days2 and3 meet the combined conditions.
distractorRationale.c: Copper’s third staffed day is day5, when Textile display is forbidden.
distractorRationale.d: Only two of Textile’s allowed days have the second guard.
distractorRationale.e: This ignores both the guard schedule and Textile’s restriction.
